notes.title: Version 1.0 is live!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1774200/Abeyance

As we promised some weeks ago, we are continuing to develop and improve [b]Abeyance[/b].
Since the launch we have released [b]19 updates[/b] addressing different problems, improved the performance, given a huge facelift to the interface and added some content.
But this is only the beginning! As we said before, we are committed to make [b]Abeyance[/b] a living universe and we plan to keep releasing new content regularly in the form of updates and DLCs, but also new games set in the Abeyance universe. It's gonna be a fun ride! Keep following us.

[previewyoutube=T1xJEHbaAu0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]ABEYANCE VERSION 1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved combat interface.
[*] Improved game stability and performance.
[*] Improved the balance of the game.
[*] Implemented the music player.
[*] Improved user experience and user interface.
[/list]
